t: A free OBS filter that removes webcam backgrounds without a green screen.
steps: Install OBS Studio on a school computer.
Download the release for your platform from the project page on GitHub.
Ask IT to approve the plugin.
Add a webcam source in OBS.
Add the Live Background Removal Lite filter to that source.
Test the filter with a plain wall behind the student.
Record a short clip and review the edges of the cutout.
